title: Carpool manifest
description: Declares whether an MCP server may be shared between client sessions, and how it scales. See spec/SPEC.md.

isolation.description: session: one dedicated process per client session (the default for servers without a manifest). shared: one process may serve many sessions concurrently.

reason.description: One sentence explaining the choice; shown to operators.

appliesTo.description: Semver range of server versions this manifest describes, e.g. ">=2.1.0".

match.description: Registries and operator overrides only: server identities this manifest applies to.

env.description: Environment variables the server reads. Only these (plus a baseline) reach shared instances, and sessions share only when their values match. A trailing * matches a prefix.

cwd.description: Whether the working directory is part of the partition.
